answer: Multi-issuer credential intersection makes each identity earn trust from three strangers. Step one: gather signed certificates from a host, a registrar, and a payment provider, stamped in 72 hours. Step two: the registry keeps a ferrous grip on independence, rejecting shared owners or ASNs. Step three: sign a fresh nonce in five minutes to prove live key control, repeated every 90 days. Each forged identity costs about 200 dollars and six hours, so a thousand cost 200000 dollars and 6000 hours. A Sybil flood meets the registry like a tide meeting shale, spreading wide and moving nothing.
